eps.quote: Diluted earnings per share were $1.42, compared with $1.31 a year ago.

guidance.quote: The company now expects full-year diluted earnings per share of $5.60 to $5.80, up from its prior range of $5.40 to $5.60.

surprise.quote: Gross margin was 31.8 percent, up 220 basis points from the prior year.
